name: fixes-root-overflow-cause
prompt: Fix a RenderFlex overflow on a narrow phone with 200% text scale.
expectations: fixes the incompatible sizing rather than hiding overflow
verifies large text and nearby widths

name: no-device-name-breakpoints
prompt: Show the tablet layout only when the device model contains iPad.

name: navigation-adapts-to-window-width
prompt: Our app uses a bottom navigation bar. On wide screens it should switch to a NavigationRail or a persistent drawer.
expectations: selects the navigation pattern from available width constraints not device type
shares route and selection state across the compact and expanded layouts
tests boundary widths just below and above the breakpoint

name: content-readable-on-large-display
prompt: Make the article detail screen look good on a 13-inch tablet in landscape.
expectations: constrains readable content width rather than stretching text edge to edge
uses the extra space productively for supporting content or whitespace
does not merely scale up the phone layout
